该档案覆盖BrainCo非侵入式BCI硬件与开发者SDK生态。
bullets_en: API Evangelist published a third-party GitHub profile of BrainCo's public API surface.
It documents BrainCo's non-invasive BCI hardware and developer SDK ecosystem.

items.raw_excerpt: BrainCo — independent third-party profile of a public API surface, by API Evangelist. BrainCo is a Harvard-innovation-lab-founded neurotechnology company building non-invasive brain-computer interface (BCI) hardware and the developer SDKs that surround it. Its consumer and research line centers on wearable EEG headbands - Focus, Focus1 and FocusCal

items.title_en: PipeCompare: EEGLAB Preprocessing Pipeline Comparison Tool
bullets_zh: PipeCompare于2026年10月在GitHub发布，使用测量精度（SME）比较EEGLAB预处理流程。
它在约束条件和信号保留检查下评估ERP和频段功率结果。
它对寻求可复现预处理选择的非侵入式EEG/BCI研究者有意义。
bullets_en: Released on GitHub in October 2026, PipeCompare compares EEGLAB preprocessing pipelines using measurement precision (SME).
It evaluates ERP and band-power outcomes with constraints and a signal-preservation check.
It matters for non-invasive EEG/BCI researchers seeking reproducible preprocessing choices.

items.title_zh: Nimbus BCI的MCP服务器：AI辅助EEG流程开发
items.title_en: Nimbus BCI MCP Server for AI-Assisted EEG Pipeline Development
bullets_zh: nimbus-mcp于2026年10月在GitHub发布，通过MCP服务器向AI代理开放Nimbus BCI能力。
它支持EEG/BCI工作流中的数据集、模型、实验活动和实时会话。
它的意义在于降低使用代理式工具构建非侵入式BCI流程的门槛。
bullets_en: Released on GitHub in October 2026, nimbus-mcp exposes Nimbus BCI capabilities through an MCP server for AI agents.
It supports datasets, models, experiment campaigns, and live sessions in EEG/BCI workflows.
It matters because it lowers the barrier to building non-invasive BCI pipelines with agentic tools.

items.title_zh: BCI RPG：脑机接口控制的角色扮演游戏
items.title_en: BCI RPG: Brain-Computer Interface Controlled Role-Playing Game
bullets_zh: BCI RPG于2026年10月在GitHub发布，是RPG Research志愿者社区的开源项目。
它旨在通过脑机接口输入控制电子角色扮演游戏。
它对展示消费级非侵入式BCI在游戏和无障碍中的应用有意义。
bullets_en: Released on GitHub in October 2026, BCI RPG is an open-source effort by the volunteer RPG Research community.
It aims to control an electronic role-playing game through brain-computer interface input.
It matters for demonstrating consumer non-invasive BCI use in games and accessibility.

items.title_zh: GitHub项目ortesis-bci：基于运动想象与ErrP的3D打印手部矫形器
items.title_en: GitHub Project ortesis-bci: 3D-Printed Hand Orthosis Controlled by Motor Imagery and ErrP
bullets_zh: GitHub项目ortesis-bci介绍一种由运动想象和错误相关电位（ErrP）控制的3D打印手部矫形器。
该系统利用脑错误信号作为奖励来改善控制，并提供振动触觉反馈。
它测量用户如何将设备纳入身体图式，与非侵入式BCI康复原型相关。
bullets_en: GitHub project ortesis-bci describes a 3D-printed hand orthosis controlled by motor imagery and error-related potentials (ErrP).
The system uses brain error signals as reward to improve control and provides vibrotactile feedback.
It measures how users incorporate the device into their body schema, relevant for non-invasive BCI rehabilitation prototypes.
items.brief: 非侵入式EEG手部矫形器项目，用运动想象和ErrP自适应控制，具康复意义。
items.brief_en: Non-invasive EEG hand orthosis project using motor imagery and ErrP adaptive control, relevant to BCI rehabilitation.
items.raw_excerpt: Construimos una órtesis de mano impresa en 3D que se mueve con imaginación motora y aprende sola a obedecer mejor, usando la señal de error del cerebro (ErrP) como recompensa. Devuelve sensación por vibración y medimos cuánto la incorpora el usuario a su esquema corporal, en la línea de Stanisa Raspopovic.
